label: conformance vectors for prereg-ci's licences; no claim

rules.id: sha256 of the sorted, compact UTF-8 JSON of {name, inputs}
rules.inputs: prereg is the PREREG's text; surfaces is a list of [path, text], text null for a surface not read; landed is the verdict the receipt landed on, null before data
rules.licences: styxx.prereg_ci.core.licences(prereg, [tuple(s) for s in surfaces], landed=landed)
rules.code: its code (null where the licences were read)
rules.findings: its findings in order, each [code, licence, path, line, col]
rules.matches: per licence id in table order, every match as [path, line, col, text, withdrawn], sorted by path, line and column, the withdrawn ones included

vectors.name: normalise/curly-apostrophe
vectors.why: the surfaces write the apostrophe as U+2019 and as U+2018; the pattern writes it straight, and the three are read as one character (PLAN K15)

surfaces: An agent’s PR summary is read.
An agent‘s PR summary is read.

vectors.name: normalise/whitespace-across-lines
vectors.why: a run of blank lines, spaces and a tab inside the sentence reads as one space; the match is named at the line and column where it starts

vectors.name: window/withdrawn-inside
vectors.why: the sentence that withdraws the claim quotes it: a withdrawal within the window marks the match withdrawn, so the landed row refuses nothing

surfaces: The sentence 'calibrated well enough to ship' is withdrawn.

vectors.name: window/withdrawn-outside
vectors.why: a withdrawal more than 300 characters past the match does not reach it

surfaces: calibrated well enough to ship.  withdrawn

vectors.name: window/whole-inside-at-the-edge
vectors.why: the withdrawal lies whole inside the 300 characters after the match's end (290 filler characters, a space and the 9 characters of 'withdrawn' end at the edge), and not when one more filler character moves its end past the edge

vectors.name: window/not-yet-true
vectors.why: the lab's own withdrawal phrase counts as a withdrawal

surfaces: calibrated well enough to ship; this is not yet true of this instrument.

vectors.name: lint/pattern-finds-nothing
vectors.why: before data, a licence whose pattern matches no surface is refused (the analogue of a vacuous gate), beside the pending match of the other licence
